positions.title: PhD Graduate Student
positions.locationName: Deborah Krakow Lab & Stanley Nelson Lab (Co-Mentorship)
positions.description:
Overview: As a graduate student researcher in the labs of Dr. Deborah Krakow and Dr. Stanley Nelson, I performed comprehensive genetic sequencing and related analysis, as well as molecular, cellular, and immunological characterization.

Key Contributions:
-Supported the research of Deborah Krakow, M.D. as a member of an interdisciplinary research team, performing exome analysis and functional characterization of identified mutations
-Developed DNA libraries for exome sequencing, helped build the Nelson lab analysis pipeline, and identified causal variants from exome/genome sequencing data.

Select Accomplishments:
-Generated multiple published research articles with additional publications planned based on results of the discovery and characterization of several novel genes in patients with the ciliopathy, short rib polydactyly syndrome.
-Improved in-house mutation annotation by helping develop a Perl-based variant annotation program.
-Leveraged Novoalign, Picard, GATK, and Ensembl expertise to help pioneer lab exomic/genomic sequencing pipeline.

positions.title: R&D Intern, Pharmacokinetics & Drug Metabolism
positions.description:
Overview:
I worked as a research and development intern in the Drug Safety Department conducting cell & molecular biology experiments. 

Select Accomplishments:
-Generated a stable cell-line expressing the renal transporter hOCT to be used as a screening tool to increase understanding of the pharmacokinetics and pharmacodynamics of ophthalmic drugs.
-Developed and delivered results to inform the Drug Safety Department.

honors.title: Kohn Research Scholarship
honors.description: One of the strongest trends in the world of higher education today is the move to increased cooperation across national borders. Of particular importance in this respect is the need for young scientists and scholars to gain experience and undertake research at universities outside their own countries.  In order to promote international cooperation in these fields, Masaryk University has established the Kohn Research Scholarship programme.
honors.issuer: Issued by Masaryk University in Brno, Czech Republic · Oct 2014

honors.title: Genome Analysis Training Program
honors.description:
The Genomic Analysis Training Program is funded by a NIH grant and supports UCLA pre-doctoral students whose goal is to conduct research in genomics. The program is designed to insure that students obtain an adequate biological, computational and statistical foundation to succeed in this important new, interdisciplinary field.
NIH Training Grant in Genomic Analysis and Interpretation T32HG002536
July 2011-June 2013

publications.title: Expanding the genetic architecture and phenotypic spectrum in the skeletal ciliopathies
Mutations in IFT-A satellite core component genes IFT43 and IFT121 produce short rib polydactyly syndrome with distinctive campomelia
